findings.evidence: _validate_arguments bounds context.artifacts only by count (4096) and validates the analysis envelope separately at 8 MiB. It does not bound aggregate analysis/context/route/demand/requirement bytes before _validate_members and _source_selection scan/validate source owners. The final 8 MiB cap is only on the generated request after source-selection work. An oversized caller-supplied context and many source-map references can therefore drive repeated owner scans outside the stated aggregate 8 MiB profile when make_provider_slice_request is called directly; the ordinary workflow happens to pre-bound its outer input, but the public builder does not.
findings.recommendation: At builder entry, bound aggregate JSON bytes across all five input values before envelope/member/source-owner traversal (and reject cycles/deep inputs). Add a pure test that passes an over-budget context and proves owner selection is not entered.
findings.title: Standalone provider request builder has no aggregate input-byte guard

findings.evidence: _own_inputs checks application only as str and does not validate occurrence. _expand dispatches run_obligation_validation before _observe_provider invokes _validate_selection, which finally rejects malformed Lean names or invalid occurrence values. Thus malformed public requests can consume a bounded native-validation worker before rejection.
findings.recommendation: Validate application syntax and the bounded integer occurrence at input ownership before native validation; add runner/worker spy cases proving bad values cause zero dispatch.
findings.title: Malformed application/occurrence are rejected only after native validation dispatch

positiveFindings: Whole expansion revalidates the analysis in the worker, rebuilds the exact candidate request from the validated v2 route/demand, and compares candidate equality before observation. The provider worker re-reads/hash-checks source, revalidates contract/source-map attachments and anchors, then expands only the caller-selected application occurrence. Observation remains explicitly unresolved, with authority none and falsity not established. Outer and worker stages clamp to 30 seconds, 12 GiB and 8 MiB; nested stop checks short-circuit. Existing missing-provider integration creates only not-dispatched request artifacts and does not synthesize a provider slice.

verification.scope: Pure request, native-binding bookkeeping, fake-runner resource, and public missing-provider hook tests. No Lean, extraction, source-fixture worker, CLI, or canonical edits.
